'''2009 Yavin 4 Regionals Brian Fred DS Imperial Occupation (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Brian Fred]] at [[2009 Yavin 4 Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Imperial Occupation (V) / Imperial Control (V) (Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth)|OVS4-40-Imperial_Occupation-remaster.webp|label=Imperial Occupation (V) / Imperial Control (V)}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Mike Honcho
* '''Deck name:''' Giant Octopus
* '''Username:''' retwin316
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
